mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (conversation_id, sender_id, content, type, created_at) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{content}, #{type}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.conversation_id AS conversationId, m.sender_id AS senderId, u.nickname AS senderNickname, m.content, m.type, m.created_at AS createdAt FROM message m INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.sender_id WHERE m.conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, conversation_id, sender_id, content, type, created_at FROM message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND type = 'AGENT' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
